data.long_description:
Step into refined elegance with this exceptional 4-bedroom standalone villa in the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club. Designed for those who appreciate sophistication, privacy, and a truly unique lifestyle, this home offers uninterrupted polo field views and world-class living.

Set within one of Dubai’s most exclusive communities, this villa combines timeless architecture with modern luxury, delivering an unparalleled residential experience.

Property Features:
⦁ 4 Spacious Bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms
⦁ Maid’s Room with separate facilities
⦁ Total of 6 Bathrooms
⦁ Expansive living and dining areas with premium finishes
⦁ Fully equipped modern kitchen
⦁ Floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking polo field views
⦁ Private swimming pool and landscaped garden
⦁ Large terrace and outdoor entertaining space
⦁ Covered parking

Community Highlights:
⦁ Exclusive polo and equestrian lifestyle
⦁ Lush green landscapes and serene surroundings
⦁ 24/7 security in a gated community
⦁ Access to luxury clubhouse, fine dining, and leisure facilities
⦁ Peaceful, low-density neighborhood offering privacy and prestige

This villa is perfect for those seeking a super luxury home in a distinctive setting, away from the city’s hustle yet well-connected to key destinations.

Rental Details:
⦁ Type: Standalone Villa
⦁ Bedrooms: 4 + Maid’s Room
⦁ Bathrooms: 6
⦁ View: Polo Field
⦁ Ready to move in

Live in a community unlike any other in Dubai—where elegance meets tranquility and every day feels like a retreat.

Contact us today to arrange a private viewing of this extraordinary home.
